# The Stoop

> The Stoop is a Pittsburgh-based digital advertising and influencer marketing agency founded in 2019 by Michael Pernice. We help brands scale through authentic influencer partnerships, paid media, organic social management, content production, and marketing automation, and we run a 1-on-1 influencer coaching program for creators building sustainable careers. Contact: mike@thestooppgh.com, +1 (412) 616-0542.

Key facts: founded in 2019 in Pittsburgh, PA, as a podcast and promotional platform for local creators and businesses (48 episodes of The Stoop Podcast), now a full-service agency; founder and CEO Michael (Mike) Pernice holds an MBA and MS in Marketing Science from the University of Pittsburgh, built and teaches Point Park University's influencer marketing course (MKTS 395), and is President of the American Marketing Association Pittsburgh Chapter; works as a collective of account managers, specialized freelancers and agency partners; 8 services; serves local Pittsburgh businesses and national clients; case studies in fitness, food & beverage, healthcare and patient advocacy, nonprofits, landscaping, sports performance, and commercial real estate. Documented results include 480,334 views for Dr. Tea's #LoveIsBrewing campaign (Valentine's Day 2023), a $47,139 nonprofit capital campaign for MFPAA in October 2025 (446 donors, 87% lower CPC than benchmarks), and 267,838 views from 15 influencers across two X Shadyside influencer campaign seasons (Q1 and Q3 2023).

Name, hours and profiles: The Stoop (legal name The Stoop LLC); Mon–Fri, 8am–6pm ET; Instagram https://www.instagram.com/thestooppgh/; Facebook https://www.facebook.com/thestooppgh/; LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/the-stoop-llc/; YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@thestooppgh; Google Business Profile https://maps.google.com/?cid=232410549620411977; founder Michael Pernice on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/michaelpernice/

## Services

- [Influencer Marketing](https://thestooppgh.com/services/influencer-marketing.html): Pittsburgh influencer marketing agency — strategy, influencer sourcing and vetting, rate negotiation, content approval, and ROI reporting; 15 Pittsburgh-area creators activated and 267K+ views across two X Shadyside campaigns
- [Influencer Coaching](https://thestooppgh.com/services/influencer-coaching.html): 1-on-1 coaching for creators from a Pittsburgh agency that runs creator campaigns — pitching brands, negotiating rates, media kits, personal brand strategy, and monetization
- [Digital Advertising](https://thestooppgh.com/services/digital-advertising.html): Pittsburgh paid media agency — strategy, creative, targeting, optimization, and reporting across Meta, TikTok, Google, YouTube, and LinkedIn; an MFPAA campaign raised $47,139 from 446 donors on a $3,645 media budget
- [Organic Social Media Management](https://thestooppgh.com/services/organic-social.html): Social media management for Pittsburgh brands on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and LinkedIn — content calendars, post creation, community management, and monthly analytics; Sylvan Gardens grew yearly Instagram reach 11.6x with $0 ad spend
- [Content Development](https://thestooppgh.com/services/content-development.html): Pittsburgh video and photo production — short-form video, long-form brand films, photography, aerial drone footage, UGC, and copywriting for social, paid, web, and print; 36 videos and 90+ color-graded photos for Iron 24
- [Design & Branding](https://thestooppgh.com/services/design-branding.html): Brand identity design from a Pittsburgh agency — logos, color palettes, type systems, brand guidelines, stationery, campaign creative, and brand films
- [Website Design & Development](https://thestooppgh.com/services/website-design.html): Custom, hand-coded, SEO-optimized websites with no templates or page builders; a typical build takes 4–8 weeks
- [Marketing Automation & Ops](https://thestooppgh.com/services/automation-ops.html): Marketing automation, CRM workflows, and operational systems — GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Zapier, and Mailchimp setup, email sequences, and lead follow-up
- [Pricing](https://thestooppgh.com/pricing.html): Published price ranges for every service; every project starts with a free consultation
- [Contact](https://thestooppgh.com/contact): One inquiry form for every service; choose a service and we reply within 24 hours, then a free 30–60 minute discovery call and a custom proposal within 48 hours

## Case Studies

- [All Case Studies](https://thestooppgh.com/work/): Pittsburgh marketing case studies with headline results — 480,334 views for Dr. Tea, $47,139 raised in 31 days for MFPAA, 267K+ views across two X Shadyside gym campaigns, and 11.6x Instagram reach in a year for Sylvan Gardens
- [X Shadyside](https://thestooppgh.com/work/x-shadyside.html): Two influencer-led membership campaigns, "New Year, New Us" (Q1 2023) and "Fall into Fitness" (Q3 2023), plus eight months of organic Instagram (May–December 2023) for a family-owned fitness facility in Pittsburgh's Shadyside neighborhood — 267K+ campaign views, 307K+ impressions, 5.8K+ link clicks, 15 influencers activated, 254 organic stories, reels and posts, 61K+ organic IG views
- [Dr. Tea](https://thestooppgh.com/work/dr-tea.html): #LoveIsBrewing Valentine's Day influencer campaign (February 4 – March 4, 2023) for a family-owned bubble tea shop in Pittsburgh's Shadyside neighborhood — two local creators, 480,334 views, 651,244 impressions, 6,154 engagements, 1,730 link clicks, 166 new followers, plus a full-service marketing proposal
- [MFPAA](https://thestooppgh.com/work/mfpaa.html): Annual marketing partner to McCandless-Franklin Park Ambulance Authority, a nonprofit EMS provider serving five Pittsburgh-area communities — the capital campaign raised $47,139 from 446 donors in 31 days (October 1–31, 2025); with the August–September 2025 subscription campaign, $50,349 in direct revenue and a 6.9x return on ad spend
- [Iron 24](https://thestooppgh.com/work/iron-24.html): Content production and influencer activation for the South Hills franchise in Pittsburgh and the corporate headquarters in Pearland, TX — 36 videos and 90+ color-graded photos across the two markets, including aerial drone footage, and 12+ local influencers activated; the Pearland work was the fall 2024 corporate shoot of 81 assets (20 videos, 60 photos, 1 drone video)
- [SXP](https://thestooppgh.com/work/sxp.html): Two brand videos (a talking-head video and a website intro with logo) for a Pittsburgh sports performance clinic inside X Shadyside, and a three-way partnership with X Shadyside and Lucid Juice, brokered in 2023, that gives members discounts at Lucid Juice
- [Sylvan Gardens](https://thestooppgh.com/work/sylvan-gardens.html): 13+ months of organic Facebook and Instagram for a landscaping company in Ingomar, PA — Instagram reach 575 → 6,690 accounts (11.6x) and 2.3x Facebook reach over the full year (Apr 2024 – Apr 2025) vs. the year before, net follower gain 43 → 181, with $0 ad spend
- [Case Specific Meal Prep](https://thestooppgh.com/work/csmp.html): One year of Instagram for a Pittsburgh meal prep and catering company — themed weekly series (Chef's Choice, Ingredient Spotlight, Influencer in the Kitchen), a monthly series of 4K chef and guest reels, logo variants and three catering menus; 15,000+ combined impact and 8,127 total views
- [Take a Nurse](https://thestooppgh.com/work/take-a-nurse.html): Brand identity system for a Pittsburgh patient-advocacy business, built in August 2026 — logo lockups in five color variants, a seven-color palette, type system, business cards, letterhead and a nine-page brand guide — then a September 2026 shoot for the new takeanurse.org: a 60-second founder film, a 30-second website hero loop and 1,008 retouched photos
- [Union Trust Building](https://thestooppgh.com/work/union-trust-building.html): Instagram and Facebook for a historic downtown Pittsburgh office landmark — event coverage, recurring video series, tenant newsletter, tenant app branding; +22% IG followers and 2.6x IG reach in six months; 2024 vs. 2023: IG reach 4,200 → 16,600, IG views 6,100 → 24,100, IG followers 821 → 1,057

## Blog

- [Anatomy of a $47K Nonprofit Capital Campaign](https://thestooppgh.com/blog/anatomy-of-a-47k-nonprofit-campaign.html): How Meta and LinkedIn ads raised $47,139 from 446 donors in 31 days for MFPAA, a Pittsburgh-area nonprofit EMS provider

- [How to Calculate Influencer Marketing ROI](https://thestooppgh.com/blog/influencer-marketing-roi-guide.html): Measuring CPM, CPC, and engagement with real data from 15+ influencer activations
- [Cross-Brand Partnerships for Local Businesses](https://thestooppgh.com/blog/cross-brand-partnerships-guide.html): How to broker partnerships between complementary local businesses, using the X Shadyside x SXP x Lucid Juice partnership as the case study
- [Pittsburgh Landscaper Social Media: 11.6x Instagram Reach](https://thestooppgh.com/blog/organic-social-growth-landscaping.html): Sylvan Gardens organic social breakdown — 38K+ impact in nine months and four times the prior year's follower growth, with zero ad spend
- [Themed Content Calendars for Food Brands](https://thestooppgh.com/blog/themed-content-calendar-food-brands.html): The weekly series format used for a year of social for Case Specific Meal Prep, a Pittsburgh meal prep brand
- [Gym Content Production at Scale: 81 Assets](https://thestooppgh.com/blog/content-production-at-scale-gym.html): Iron 24 corporate shoot breakdown — 20 videos, 60 photos and 1 drone video across four shoot blocks
- [Social Media for a Historic Pittsburgh Office Building](https://thestooppgh.com/blog/social-media-historic-office-building.html): Union Trust Building organic social breakdown — recurring Instagram series that grew followers 22% and quarterly reach 2.6x
- [The Tenant Event Content Playbook](https://thestooppgh.com/blog/tenant-event-content-playbook.html): How to cover tenant events for a commercial property — two reels, five stories, and a newsletter recap per event, as we ran it at the Union Trust Building
- [Pittsburgh Brand Shoot: A Founder Film and 1,008 Photos](https://thestooppgh.com/blog/healthcare-brand-shoot-founder-film.html): Take a Nurse brand shoot breakdown — one four-hour window on September 16, 2026, a crew of two, six scenes, a 60-second founder film, a 30-second website hero loop and 1,008 retouched photos
